description: CSCN-SEM knockdown prediction: model definitions, frozen before any prediction run. Outputs are predicted pseudobulk expression changes per model, held-out target, condition and cross-fit direction; no held-out evaluation quantity is computed here (config/evaluation_endpoints.json).
allowed_response_data: the held-out target's own perturbed-gene expression on its calibration fold (delta)

orientation.outer_folds: config/target_split.json folds 0-4; training targets = targets not in fold f
orientation.evidence: per (fold, condition): target - NTC mean difference of log1p CP10k for every panel gene (destination != source), Welch t-test, BH within (fold, condition); all cells of training targets and all NTC cells of the condition
orientation.knockdown_pass: negative change of the training target's own panel node (all 56 targets are eligible)
orientation.pipeline: starting PDAG -> icpdag.intervention_orientation.seed_interventions (extension_check = relaxed rule) -> official Meek rules (apply_r4 false) -> official DAG completion (_build_dag_representation) with the unified fallback completion rule
orientation.extension_rule: for every graph-based model: the official completion is accepted if it is a valid extension (same skeleton, fixed edges kept, same unshielded colliders, acyclic); otherwise it is accepted under the relaxed rule (same skeleton, every fixed seeded or Meek-oriented edge kept, acyclic; colliders may change) and counted as a fallback completion per model, fold and condition. The seed compatibility check (seed_interventions extension_check) and the local IDA choices use the same rule.
orientation.history: 2026-10-21 (Checkpoint A, structure only): the collider-preserving rule alone left 6.1% of DMSO cell-specific fold DAGs without a completion (all 56 DMSO targets above the 5% exclusion flag); the fallback, first introduced for the local association model only, now applies to every model.

local_ida.applies_to: the held-out target g in every graph-based model
local_ida.rule: U = undirected edges incident to g in the seeded + Meek PDAG; enumerate parent sets S of g among U's neighbours that create no new unshielded collider at g (S is a clique and every node of S is adjacent to every directed parent of g; Maathuis et al. 2009); for each S orient S -> g and g -> (U minus S), apply Meek, complete with the unified fallback completion rule; drop and count choices whose completion fails even under the relaxed rule
local_ida.cell_prediction: equal-weight mean of the per-choice predictions over the valid choices
local_ida.stop_rule: if |U| > 10 in any cell of any model, stop and report
local_ida.cell_exclusion: no reference cell is excluded for a failed collider-preserving completion (the fallback applies); a cell is excluded from a target's pseudobulk mean only if no choice has a completion even under the relaxed rule, and (model, target, condition) rows with > 5% of reference cells excluded are flagged
local_ida.history: 2026-10-21 (Checkpoint A): limit raised from 8 to 10 (one local association unit had |U| = 9).

shared.rule: target-coverage-matched population PC: the vendored PC-stable skeleton search and unshielded-collider orientation with the CI test replaced by a population Spearman partial correlation (Fisher z on all NTC cells of the condition), max conditioning as config/cscn_networks.json (4); z_crit = the largest threshold (sparsest graph) at which the number of the 56 targets with >= 1 incident edge is >= the number of targets with an edge in >= 10% of the same cells' CSCN graphs (DMSO 35, Vem 32)
shared.search: start at the level-0 bound (largest threshold at which enough targets have a marginal edge), lower by factors of 0.9 until the PC skeleton covers enough targets, then bisect (40 steps); the largest evaluated z_crit with enough coverage is used
shared.threshold: independence iff |atanh(r)| * sqrt(n - |Z| - 3) < z_crit; reported alpha = 2 * sf(z_crit)
shared.runtime_guard: abort if any single PC fit takes longer than 600 s
shared.why_not_cscn_single_neighbourhood: with a window covering all cells every gene's neighbourhood is all cells and the CSCN count statistic is 0, so the graph is empty; population PC at alpha 0.10 is too dense (level-1 degree 35-100, every target > 8 incident edges)
shared.history: 2026-10-21 (Checkpoint A, structure only): edge-count matching (median cell-specific edge count) connected only 11/56 (DMSO) and 21/56 (Vem) targets, against 35/32 targets with an edge in >= 10% of cells, so most shared-model predictions would be constant; replaced by target-coverage matching before any prediction. The first runtime guard (level-0 edges <= 20 x median cell edges) stopped the DMSO search at a graph whose PC fit took about 5 s; it was replaced by the direct 600 s per-fit guard.

cluster.rule: k-means (n_init 20, seed) on the 20 PCs; per cluster the shared-graph rule on the cluster's NTC cells, with the coverage requirement = the number of targets with an edge in >= 10% of that cluster's cells' CSCN graphs

local_association.rule: per cell k: the gene pairs with the largest absolute Pearson correlation of log1p CP10k within N(k) (no conditioning), as many as cell k's CSCN skeleton edges (density-matched); ties by node order; genes without variance in N(k) excluded; all edges undirected (no separating sets, hence no collider step), then the same orientation pipeline
local_association.history: 2026-10-21 (Checkpoint A, structure only): with the collider-preserving rule only 48% of the association fold DAGs had a valid completion and every target exceeded the 5% exclusion flag.

pcs.input: panel log1p CP10k of the condition's NTC cells, centred, not scaled, full SVD

coefficients.equation: x_j = a_j + sum_{l in pa(j)} b_jl x_l + e_j on log1p CP10k
coefficients.neighbourhood: N(k) = the round(0.35 x n) nearest NTC cells of the same condition (Euclidean in the 20 PCs, k included, stable ties), uniform weights; 0.35 matches the CSCN window
coefficients.local_estimator: b = argmin sum_{i in N(k)} (x_ij - a - b'x_i,pa)^2 + lambda |N(k)| ||b - b_pooled||^2, intercept unpenalised
coefficients.b_pooled: OLS (minimum-norm least squares) with the same parent set on all NTC cells of the condition
coefficients.lambda_selection: one lambda per condition by NTC-only cross-validation: for c in {0, 1}, each NTC cell of calib_fold 1-c uses its fold-specific completed DAG, a neighbourhood of round(0.35 x n_c) nearest calib_fold-c NTC cells and b_pooled from calib_fold c, and predicts each node with >= 1 parent from its parents; mean squared error over nodes and cells, averaged over both directions and the 5 fold-specific DAG sets; argmin over the grid. lambda = infinity (pure b_pooled) is reported as a reference row and is not selectable; a selected lambda at a grid boundary is reported, the grid is not extended. No perturbation response enters this choice.
coefficients.simulation: Delta x(k, g) = (I - B_k)^-1 e(g) delta by forward substitution in topological order
coefficients.pseudobulk: mean of Delta x(k, g) over all NTC reference cells of the condition (excluded cells removed)

delta.rule: delta(g, d, c) = mean log1p CP10k of gene g in target-g cells of calib_fold c minus the same in NTC cells of calib_fold c; evaluated later on calib_fold 1 - c
delta.storage: per-unit-delta prediction and the delta-scaled prediction for each direction c

models.cell_specific_cscn_sem: primary model: per-cell stored PDAGs -> fold-specific orientation -> local IDA -> local ridge-to-pooled coefficients
models.shared_cscn_sem: primary reference: one density-matched population PC graph per condition -> same orientation and local IDA -> b_pooled estimated with the shared graph's own parent sets on all NTC cells of the condition (no locality)
models.cluster_level_sem: K = 6 clusters per condition; each cluster's density-matched graph -> same orientation and local IDA -> OLS pooled within the cluster with that cluster graph's own parent sets; each reference cell uses its cluster's model
models.local_association_network_sem: per-cell density-matched association skeleton -> same orientation and local IDA -> local ridge-to-pooled coefficients (same lambda as the primary model)
models.unweighted_propagation_ablation: the cell_specific_cscn_sem DAGs and IDA choices with b_jl = 1 / |pa(j)| (no fitting, no signs)
models.zero_downstream_baseline: Delta x = 0 for every downstream gene: the per-unit change vector is the perturbed gene's unit vector (Delta x_g = delta, all other panel genes 0); the evaluation excludes the perturbed gene, so its predicted downstream change is exactly 0 (RMSE only, as pre-registered)

fufa_score_shift: frozen Aim 1 scoring (config/aim1.json, icpdag.program_scores; same program genes, background controls, DMSO NTC centre and scale) applied linearly: shift = (mean of program-gene changes - mean of control changes) / scale; genes outside the panel change by 0 for every model

weak_targets.rule: all 56 targets enter every analysis; nothing is excluded for weak connectivity; the pre-registered NaN rule applies unchanged
weak_targets.stratum: connected = an edge in >= 10% of NTC cells in both conditions (results/summary/cscn_panel_target_connectivity.csv); descriptive stratum only, not a test

limitations: The shared and cluster graphs use a population Spearman partial-correlation test, whereas the cell-specific graphs use the local CSCN count test; the comparison therefore differs in test family as well as in locality. Target-coverage matching equalises the number of targets with an incident edge, not the number of edges.

The local association model has no separating sets, so no collider orientation; its edges are oriented by intervention seeds, Meek rules, local IDA and the official completion, which may add colliders (fallback completion).
Fallback completions (relaxed rule) may introduce v-structures not supported by the data; their share is reported per model, fold and condition.

evaluation_amendment.summary: constant predictions get Pearson r = 0 (z = 0) in the primary decision test, so all 56 targets enter; the complete-pairs analysis becomes supporting; Wilcoxon zero differences: zero_method 'wilcox' (pairs with zero difference dropped, count reported)
evaluation_amendment.reason: under the shared model 40 of 56 targets have a constant prediction in at least one condition; complete pairs would leave 16 targets selected by shared-graph connectivity

outputs.predictions: outputs/sem_prediction/predictions/<condition>/fold<f>/predictions.npz: per-unit and delta-scaled pseudobulk change vectors per model and held-out target (both cross-fit directions), deltas, included reference cells, per-cell Fufa score shifts (per unit and scaled)
